whatWasReviewed: the acceptance instrument itself, before any code was written, on the grounds that a measurement taken with a broken instrument is worse than no measurement

findings.finding: the first version of the /MarkInfo check tested `deref(mi.get('/Marked')) is True`. pypdf returns a BooleanObject, which is never IDENTICAL to Python True, so the check reported all six of the planner's own conformant reference PDFs as unmarked.
findings.howFound: ran the instrument against six PDFs already known to be conformant and got the wrong answer for all six; the dispatch's own claim of '/MarkInfo /Marked true' on those files disagreed with my output, and the disagreement was the finding
findings.resolution: compare with `== True`, which BooleanObject implements correctly in both directions
findings.verifiedBy: BooleanObject(True) == True -> True; BooleanObject(False) == True -> False

findings.severity: instrument defect, fail-OPEN, caught before it shipped
findings.finding: the obvious repair for CP1-F1 is `bool(x)`. pypdf's BooleanObject defines no __bool__, so bool(BooleanObject(False)) is True: a PDF explicitly declaring /Marked false would have read as marked.
findings.howFound: probed both repairs against both values instead of only against the value I expected

findings.finding: the dispatch states 413 extracted lines of which 268 single-character (64.9%). My rule counts 416 lines / 268 single-character (64.42%) on the same file. The numerator agrees exactly; the denominator differs by 3 blank lines.
findings.resolution: not rounded off. Both denominators are reported everywhere the ratio appears (all lines, and non-blank lines).
findings.planner_figure_status: substantially correct; the difference is a stated counting rule, not an error

designDecisionsTaken: the order check walks /StructTreeRoot /K depth-first and locates each MCID by evaluating the page content stream's CTM and text matrix, because a tree in the wrong order passes every other check

the order check must be shown PASSING on a real conformant file before it is trusted, or it is a permanently-red gate (DEV_PROCESS 2.0). Confirmed: 0 inversions on all three pages of the planner's remediation-plan PDF
every one of the six checks must be observed failing in isolation on a deliberately broken input before any of them is reported as working
goNoGo: GO. Instrument discriminates: known-bad site plan PASS=false at 64.42%, six known-good references PASS=true at 0.0 to 1.12%.
